messages:
chris: quick security ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8423 ready for review. Changes: add on-prem VPC mode checks, auth middleware change to validate client certs when REDWOOD_PRIVATE=true, wire up KMS for service credential encryption, and a migration script that base64-decodes existing keys then re-encrypts with KMS. Want to merge today if no blockers. cc @priya @rachel :wave:

priya: :eyes: I'll take a look in ~1h. two quick asks up front: 1) did you update the threat-model doc to include client-cert auth? 2) don't merge until SAST is green for the migration script — base64 decode + file IO often gets flagged.

rachel: noted — on-prem ops: we need an HSM/KMS config flag in the inventory and default to disabled. also please ensure no key material is ever logged. tiny example: `logger.debug("re-encrypting key: %s", redacted)` is OK, `logger.info("key: %s", key)` is not.

mike: ran local static scan on the branch, saw one finding in scripts/migrate_keys.py: `base64.b64decode(payload)` followed by write to `/tmp/` — flagged as potential secret persistence. suggest using the secretstore client instead of writing plaintext to disk.

chris: thanks — will: 1) add threat-model note and link in PR description, 2) change migrate to stream into SecretStore client (no disk), 3) remove any non-redacted logs. pushing a patch in ~20m. question: is infra signoff required for canary merge, or can security + eng-ops OK?

priya: infra needs to greenlight on-prem config changes because it affects deployment manifests. no admin-override for this one. prefer a canary in staging -> perf + auth smoke tests -> then prod rollout.

rachel: agree with priya. if infra gives a thumbs we can roll a 10% canary for 1 hour then increase. also add a feature-flag so we can disable client-cert enforcement quickly if needed.

chris: ack — adding feature flag REDWOOD_CLIENT_CERT_ENFORCE=false by default and a rollout plan in the PR template. will also add a QA checklist for infra (inventory + HSM config).

deploy-bot: CI / PR #8423 — checks: unit-tests: passed, integration-tests: running, sast: queued, deploy-scan: pending.

mike: once you push, I'll re-run the scan. also please include a small unit test for the fallback path when KMS is unreachable.

chris: pushed fixes (force-push); updated PR description with threat-model link and checklist, replaced disk write with SecretStore streaming, removed sensitive logs, added feature flag, added unit test for KMS-fallback.

mike: re-scanned — SAST now clean for the migrate script. integration tests failing in one auth path (timing out on cert validation) — looks like a test harness issue, not prod code. rerunning.

priya: I reviewed the auth middleware diff. small nit: please add an explicit error code when cert verification fails so clients don't treat it as network flakiness. otherwise LGTM from security side once infra confirms canary plan. :+1:

rachel: infra confirmed via DM — HSM config exists and inventory change is fine. canary approved. please coordinate with oncall for rollout window (avoid backup jobs window).

chris: great — scheduling a 10% canary at 02:00 UTC, 1h window, rollback plan in PR. merging after integration tests finish and deploy-scan passes. thanks all :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: CI / PR #8423 — integration-tests: passed, sast: passed, deploy-scan: passed. status: ready to merge.

mike: quick follow-up: after merge, can we add an automated check that ensures no `logger.*\(".*key|secret` patterns get merged? small linter rule.

priya: +1 on linter — filing a follow-up issue.

chris: merging now. will monitor canary and post updates in #eng-oncall. thanks everyone! :tada:
